title: defer/subscribe payload
description: The Observed Agent sends this payload to subscribe to the resolution of a deferred step. Specification 6.6 defines the subscription.

deferred_request_id.description: The request_id that the request of the deferred step carried (Specification 6.6).

PendingNotification.description: The complete defer/pending message: a JSON-RPC 2.0 Notification from the Guardian, so it has no id.

PendingParams.description: params of the one defer/pending notification for a pending deferral. The notification carries no decision and no signature.

deferred_request_id.description: The deferred_request_id of the subscription, so the Observed Agent can correlate the notification on a shared channel such as stdio.
